resources.string: Paste one here, or share it from any app.
Wherever you are — YouTube, TikTok, a browser — use Share → Riplox Send. Nothing opens; the link is on its way.
Only the link travels — never a video, and never anything else on this phone.
Your PC is on and this phone is allowed.
Your PC has this phone paused. Resume it there.
Your PC removed this phone. Pair it again with a new code.
It is switched off, or Riplox is not running on it. Links you send still wait for it.
Pair this phone with your PC to start sending.
This phone cannot reach the internet.
1. Open Riplox\n2. Sharing → Show code\n3. Copy code, and paste it below
The code works once and lasts two minutes. After that it opens nothing, so an old code left in a chat is harmless.
Paired. Share a link from any app and it goes straight to your PC.
A pairing is saved on this phone. Home shows whether your PC still accepts it.
That code does not look right. Copy it again from Riplox.
That code has already been used. Make a new one in Riplox.
That code has expired. Make a new one in Riplox.
Your PC would not accept that code.
No answer from your PC. Open Riplox, turn Sharing on, and use a fresh code.
Could not reach the relay. Check your connection.
Version %1$s · %2$d KB. Installs over this one — your pairing stays.
Turn on “Allow from this source”, then tap Update again.
Left for your PC. It starts as soon as Riplox is running.
There was no link in that.
Sending that text to your PC…
That is too long to send. Keep it under about 2,900 characters.
Pair this phone with your PC first.
